crossRefs.note: Behold, a voice out of the heavens said, “This is my beloved Son, with whom I am well pleased.”
Therefore still having one, his beloved son, he sent him last to them, saying, ‘They will respect my son.’
The lord of the vineyard said, ‘What shall I do? I will send my beloved son. It may be that seeing him, they will…
No one has seen God at any time. The one and only Son, who is in the bosom of the Father, has declared him.
I have seen, and have testified that this is the Son of God.”
For God so loved the world, that he gave his one and only Son, that whoever believes in him should not perish, but have…
The Father loves the Son, and has given all things into his hand.
One who believes in the Son has eternal life, but one who disobeys the Son won’t see life, but the wrath of God remains…
God, having in the past spoken to the fathers through the prophets at many times and in various ways,
has at the end of these days spoken to us by his Son, whom he appointed heir of all things, through whom also he made…
What could have been done more to my vineyard, that I have not done in it? Why, when I looked for it to yield grapes…
It may be that the house of Judah will hear all the evil which I intend to do to them; that they may each return from…
I said, “Just fear me. Receive correction, so that her dwelling won’t be cut off, according to all that I have…

parallels.note: Therefore still having one, his beloved son, he sent him last to them, saying, ‘They will respect my son.’

translations.web: But afterward he sent to them his son, saying, ‘They will respect my son.’
translations.bsb: Finally, he sent his son to them. ‘They will respect my son,’ he said.
translations.kjv: But last of all he sent unto them his son, saying, They will reverence my son.
translations.asv: But afterward he sent unto them his son, saying, They will reverence my son.
